messages:
Elaine (PM): Quick heads-up — spotted a layout issue on the Usage > Consumption chart when the viewport is narrow: the legend and the invoice CTA overlap on tablet/narrow desktop. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/consumption-cta-overlap.png

Raj (Designer): I’m on it. I pushed a Figma tweak proposing two responsive states:
- >900px: legend stays inline to the right of the chart
- <=900px: legend collapses into a horizontal chip row under the chart or into a dropdown trigger depending on available width

Marta (Frontend): Dropdown is safer for preserving the invoice CTA. When the legend becomes tall it pushes the CTA off-canvas on some dashboards. Dropdown will keep a single-line header height.

Sam (Data-Viz): Heads-up — token breakdown counts are long for some customers (hundreds of token buckets). If we show chips, they’ll overflow. Proposal: show top-3 tokens + a "+N" chip that opens the full list on click/hover. That keeps the primary CTA visible.

Oliver (Eng): Agree with dropdown or top3+"+N". If we do a dropdown, we need keyboard nav and proper focus management (escape to close, arrow keys to traverse). Also recommend a feature flag (compactLegend) so we can roll out safely.

Aria (Billing Ops): Important: invoices CTA ("View invoices") is the primary action for billing admins — don’t hide or demote it visually. If the legend moves, ensure the invoice button remains the highest-contrast primary CTA and is first in DOM order for keyboard users.

Raj (Designer): Mock CSS snippet I added to the figma notes:```css
.legend { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.legend--condensed { max-width: 240px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.legend-dropdown { position: relative; }
.legend-dropdown__panel { position: absolute; right: 0; z-index: 40; }
```
(We can refine spacing/token chips once devs try it.)

Marta (Frontend): For accessibility: add role="list" on the legend container and role="listitem" on chips + aria-expanded on the dropdown trigger. I’ll put those notes in the PR template so QA checks them.

Oliver (Eng): Implementation plan: add compactLegend feature flag + basic unit tests for rendering top3 and dropdown states. Will mock large token sets in the test harness. ETA: EOW for flag + skeleton, follow-up PR for styles.

Sam (Data-Viz): I’ll supply sample algorithm for "top3 by spend" vs "top3 by token count" — both matter depending on whether users care about USD/pricing vs raw tokens. Will attach sample dataset in the design doc.

Elaine (PM): Awesome. Action items summary: @Raj update Figma with dropdown + top3 variants, @Marta add aria roles + include checks in PR template, @Oliver feature flag + tests, @Sam attach sample algorithm/dataset, @Aria confirm invoice CTA contrast/DOM order. Follow-up sync Fri 11:00am PT. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

InvoiceBot: Invoice #INV-2026-042 attached for acct-6789 (auto): https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-042.json

Marta (Frontend): noted the follow-up. I’ll flag any tricky edge cases in the PR early to avoid rework.
